params.name: select
params.description: Specify comma-separated list of fields to include into response or leave it undefined to return full object. If you select single field, response will be an array of values in both `.fields` and `.values` modes.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sorts blocks by specified field. Supported fields: `id` (default), `level`, `payloadRound`, `blockRound`, `attestationPower`, `reward`, `bonus`, `fees`.

params.name: offset
